configurePresets.name: linux-cross-debug
configurePresets.description: Cross-compiles Stand.dll on Linux using clang-cl. Requires LLVM (clang-cl) and msvc-wine; see cmake/cross-compile.cmake.

configurePresets.description: Cross-compiles Stand.dll on Linux using clang-cl. Requires LLVM (clang-cl) and msvc-wine; see cmake/cross-compile.cmake.

configurePresets.name: windows-debug
configurePresets.description: Builds Stand.dll natively on Windows with MSVC or clang-cl. Pick a matching CMake Tools kit (e.g. "Visual Studio Build Tools 2022 - amd64" or an LLVM/clang-cl kit) before configuring, so cl.exe/clang-cl.exe and the Windows SDK are on the environment - no full Visual Studio IDE required.
